title: TACHOMETER - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the specific procedures for removing and installing the tachometer sending unit on an aircraft with Garmin G1000 systems, including precautions for electrical connections?
answer: On airplanes with standard avionics, the engine speed  is measured by an indicator found in the cockpit. The tachometer maintenance practices give removal and installation procedures for the tachometer and drive cable.On airplanes with Garmin G1000, the engine speed  is measured by the tachometer sending unit and changed to an electrical signal. The Garmin Control Display Units  display the engine speed. The tachometer maintenance practices give removal and installation procedures for the tachometer sending unit. Tachometer and Drive Cable Removal/installation NOTE:  Airplanes without Garmin G1000 have a tachometer and drive cable.Remove Tachometer and Drive Cable . (1) On backside of instrument panel, disconnect drive cable from tachometer. (2) Disconnect electrical connector  from backside of tachometer. (3) Remove screws securing tachometer to instrument panel and remove tachometer. (4) Remove upper engine cowling. Refer to Chapter 71, Engine Cowling - Maintenance Practices. (5) Disconnect drive cable at rear of accessory case. (6)  Remove two screws securing firewall shield to firewall. (7) Withdraw drive cable through firewall.Install Tachometer and Drive Cable . (2) Connect drive cable to accessory case housing. Install firewall shield to firewall using screws. Install tachometer to instrument panel using four screws. (5) Connect electrical connector  to tachometer. (6) Connect drive cable to backside of tachometer. Reinstall upper engine cowling. Refer to Chapter 71, Engine Cowling - Maintenance Practices. Airplanes with Garmin G 1000 have a tachometer sending unit.Remove the Tachometer Sending Unit . Make sure the MASTER switch is in the off position. Remove the top cowl. Refer to Chapter 71, Cowl - Maintenance Practices. Remove the tachometer sending unit from the airplane.Install the Tachometer Sending Unit . Put the tachometer sending unit in position on the airplane. (3) Connect the electrical connector . If irregular tachometer indications have occurred, the use of Stabilant 22 contact enhancer on the electrical connector  can possibly decrease the occurrence (4) Install the side cowl. Refer to Chapter 71, Cowl - Maintenance Practices.
